name: The Legend of Divinity
source:
The Legend of Divinity is a romantic novel about the world of magic and how it works. You are a wolf who leaves his home and moves to a magic academy. You will be told how magic works in this world. Lots of interesting and captivating characters. Fights, duels and the study of sorcery are waiting.

But how is it realeted to the legend of the god? What do they have in common? This is exactle what the book "The Legend of Divinity" tell you. 

[From [url=https://spark-of-mad.itch.io/the-legend-of-divinity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《神界传奇》是一部关于魔法世界及其运作方式的浪漫小说。你是一只离开家来到魔法学院的狼。你将被告知魔法在这个世界上是如何运作的。许多有趣且迷人的角色。战斗、决斗和魔法研究都在等待着。

但这又是如何与神的传说联系起来的呢？他们有什么共同点？这正是《神界传奇》这本书告诉你的。

[来自[url=https://spark-of-mad.itch.io/the-legend-of-divinity]Itch.io[/url]]
